g.text: Move from cue-locked analysis to a safe, personalized, real-time BCI
Standardize when motor intent should occur.
Repeated sessions in healthy and stroke participants
Use early calibration; lock later sessions for testing.
Store raw EEG, cue timing, artifacts, function scores,
Keep EEG central; use other signals to verify intent.
EMG: attempt ground truth | fNIRS: cortical evidence
IMU / force: movement and device-response verification
Test confirmation, abstention, and device control.
